title: Almost perfect
body: Apple Notes is a very useful app for quick organization, but it would be much better if it allowed easier table customization. It would be great to be able to freely modify the number of columns, similar to how tables work in Apple Pages, where editing is much more intuitive and flexible. Additionally, adding support for lines and basic geometric shapes would significantly improve note structure and visual clarity, especially for students and creative users.
